Title: Create DesktopText core model and manager
Description: Add a parallel DesktopText data model and manager for pinned text overlays, with independent storage and lifecycle management.
Acceptance: A dedicated text item + manager stack exists, supports create/update/pin/close, and stores pinned text separately from screenshot items.
Test_Method: unit tests for model round-trip + manual code inspection
Notes: Implemented with PinnedTextItem/PinnedTextManager, passing PinnedText model tests, and reviewed before commit.

Title: Implement pinned text window and preview surface
Description: Build a borderless floating desktop window and preview content view for pinned text overlays, reusing screenshot-window interaction semantics where appropriate.
Acceptance: A text overlay can render as a themed preview object, float above apps, move, resize, and adjust opacity in a screenshot-consistent way.
Notes: Implemented and covered by window state tests. Visual hover/glow UAT passed; broader desktop interaction matrix still partially manual.

Title: Add lightweight Markdown preview and themed edit mode
Description: Implement the approved lightweight Markdown subset for preview plus a themed edit mode entered only by double-click.
Acceptance: Preview supports headings/paragraphs/line breaks/list/bold, and double-click enters themed editing without falling back to a raw-looking text box.
Test_Method: unit tests for parser/rendering + manual preview/edit round-trip
Notes: Implemented with PinnedTextMarkdownRenderer and edit/commit tests; preview/edit typography reviewed.

Title: Wire clipboard-first entry and default pinned creation
Description: Add the first user-visible entry surface for clipboard pinning and create a default-pinned text overlay from current pasteboard text without breaking existing clipboard pipeline behavior.
Acceptance: A menu-bar-visible entry creates a default-pinned overlay from clipboard text; empty clipboard path fails gracefully; Message Panel clipboard pipeline remains unchanged.
Test_Method: manual app flow test from menu bar
Notes: Menu item and manager API are implemented and reviewed; manual Message Panel regression remains partially tracked.

Title: Add persistence
Test_Method: Verify pinned text overlays persist, restore after relaunch, and respect pin/unpin/lock/close semantics.
Tools: Pinned text overlays restore correctly after relaunch and lifecycle actions remain consistent with their saved state.
Dev_Status: unit tests for persistence + manual relaunch test
column14: Persistence and restore behavior are covered by tests and reviewed.

Title: Run full verification and manual UAT matrix
Description: Run build/test/concurrency plus the agreed manual acceptance matrix for clipboard creation, preview/edit transitions, gestures, and restore behavior.
Acceptance: All automated checks pass and manual UAT confirms clipboard -> pinned overlay, double-click edit, gesture controls, and restore behavior with no screenshot/clipboard regressions.
Test_Method: swift build + swift test + concurrency script + manual matrix
Notes: Automated checks passed: swift build, swift test, strict concurrency. Visual UAT for hover/glow passed; full manual matrix remains partially tracked.
